title: Every Adult Should Learn Cartwheels
description:

Maybe you’ve tried to learn to do a cartwheel in the past few years and didn’t have any luck, or maybe you’ve just always assumed you couldn’t do it.

The cartwheel progressions I’ll show you in this #shorts will remove much of that fear. Instead of jumping up and trying to throw your legs over your head, and hoping you land without hurting yourself, you’ll start with very small steps that help you ease into the feeling of being upside down.

Plus, as you work on these progressions, you’ll start building up strength, flexibility, and control throughout your body, which will not only make cartwheeling easier but also any other skill you want to learn.
